text: 検査推奨 記憶エリア / はいはい / はいは一度で認識可能
translation: Inspection recommended: Memory area / Yes, yes / 'Yes' can be recognized in one instance
grammar: 推奨 is used as a noun here meaning 'recommendation'. で marks the means/method.

text: はーい
translation: Okay

text: 記憶エリアチェック完了 問題なし / 了解 / 検査推奨 視覚センサー処理系 / はーい
translation: Memory area check complete. No problems / Understood / Inspection recommended: Visual sensor processing system / Okay
grammar: なし means 'without, none'. センサー is the English loanword 'sensor'.

text: 視覚センサー処理系チェック完了 / 問題なす / 全チェック完了
translation: Visual sensor processing system check complete / No problems / All checks complete
grammar: 問題なす appears to be a casual/truncated form of 問題なし.

text: ふぅ / ようやく全部のチェックが終わった
translation: Phew / Finally finished all the checks
grammar: Past tense た form indicates completion.

text: データオーバーホールとかやりすぎだよ / 機体9Sは敵に旅客され長時間の操作不能状態にあった / その間に敵のロンリウイルスの潜伏を許してしまった可能性が
translation: A data overhaul and such is overkill / Unit 9S was captured by the enemy and was in an inoperable state for a long time / There's a possibility that during that time, the enemy's logic virus was allowed to lie dormant

vocabulary.meaning: to permit, to allow, to forgive

grammar: とか indicates 'things like'. され is passive form. てしまった indicates regrettable completion. Note: 旅客 (りょかく) normally means 'passenger' but here seems to be 捕獲 (ほかく) 'capture'. ロンリウイルス is 'logic virus'.

text: 分かった分かった / あとはバンカーのサーバーとデータを同期したら終わりだね
translation: I get it, I get it / After this, if we synchronize the data with the Bunker's server, we're done
grammar: したら is conditional 'if/when we do'. だね is casual confirmation particle. バンカー is 'bunker', サーバー is 'server'.

text: 何?今の / 不明 / データ同期を中止 / 警告
translation: What? What was that just now? / Unknown / Halt data synchronization / Warning
grammar: 今の refers to 'the thing just now'.

text: データ同期は全流破棄隊の義務工程 / 不明瞭なノイズがあったからね。
translation: Data synchronization is a mandatory process for all YoRHa forces / Because there was an unclear noise
grammar: からね explains the reason. 全流破棄隊 appears to be a mishearing/OCR error for ヨルハ部隊 (YoRHa forces). ノイズ is 'noise'.

text: 2Bのデータ同期プロセスも一旦保留しておいて。 / 了解。
translation: Put 2B's data synchronization process on hold for now too / Understood
grammar: ておいて means 'to do in advance/for later'. プロセス is 'process'.

text: 万全を期するために、データノイズの原因を探す。 / サーバーへのポートを開いて。
translation: To ensure perfection, I'll search for the cause of the data noise / Open the port to the server

vocabulary.meaning: to expect, to set (a date), to resolve
to search for, to look for

grammar: ために indicates purpose 'in order to'. ポート is 'port' (computer term).

text: 全部調べるのは無理だな。 / 重要なポイントに絞って調べよう
translation: It's impossible to check everything / Let's narrow it down to the important points and investigate
grammar: のは nominalizes the verb. に絞って means 'narrowing down to'. よう is volitional form suggesting 'let's'. ポイント is 'point'.

text: どうして防壁がこんなところに / これは月面への資材搬入記録か / でも変だな
translation: Why is there a firewall in a place like this? / Is this a record of materials being transported to the lunar surface? / But that's strange
grammar: こんなところ means 'a place like this'. か indicates a question. だな is casual confirmation.

text: 空のコンテナがやたらある / なんでこんな無意味なことしてるんだろう
translation: There are a ton of empty containers / I wonder why they're doing something so meaningless
grammar: やたらある means 'there are excessively many'. んだろう expresses wondering. コンテナ is 'container'.

text: 検出 / ヨウハ機体保管起落
translation: Detected / YoRHa unit storage records
grammar: 起落 appears to be 記録 (きろく) 'records'. ヨウハ is YoRHa.

text: こんなに厳重に防御する意味ってなんだろう / ブラックボックスに関する情報だけ
translation: I wonder what the point is of protecting this so heavily / Only the information related to the black box
grammar: って is casual topic marker. なんだろう expresses wondering. に関する means 'related to'. ブラックボックス is 'black box'.

text: 全部潰されてる
translation: It's all been erased

vocabulary.meaning: to crush, to destroy, to erase

grammar: されてる is contraction of されている, passive progressive form.

text: 新しいポートが開いた
translation: A new port has opened
grammar: Past tense indicates completed action. ポート is 'port'.

text: 攻撃型の防撃? / こんなのをサーバー内部に設置するなんて
translation: Offensive-type defenses? / To think they'd install something like this inside the server

vocabulary.meaning: defense (likely 防御 ぼうぎょ)

grammar: なんて expresses surprise or disbelief. サーバー is 'server'.

text: このデータ / ヨルハ計画の中に人類会議策定の見出しが入ってる
translation: This data... Inside the YoRHa Project there's a heading about the establishment of the Council of Humanity
grammar: の中に means 'inside of'. てる is contraction of ている. ヨルハ is YoRHa.

text: これじゃ順番が逆
translation: This way, the order is backwards
grammar: じゃ is contraction of では. が marks the subject.

text: アモノの戦いと冒険を経て / 預言者が言う
translation: Through battles and adventures of Amo / The prophet says
grammar: を経て means 'through, via, after going through'. と connects nouns. アモノ might be a character name.

text: ああ男女の慈悲
translation: Ah, the mercy of man and woman
grammar: ああ is an interjection expressing emotion. Note: This might be 大地 (だいち) 'earth/land' rather than 男女.

text: ああ天上の喜びを
translation: Ah, the joy of heaven
grammar: を marks the object. This appears to be poetic/religious language.

text: 鉄の組み木から解き放たれ / 私たちの魂が
translation: Released from iron shackles / Our souls
grammar: れ is passive form. から indicates 'from'. Note: 組み木 might be 首輪 (くびわ) 'collar/shackles' or 軛 (くびき) 'yoke'.

text: 今のは一体
translation: What on earth was that just now?

vocabulary.meaning: what on earth, in the world (emphasis)

grammar: 今の refers to 'that just now'. 一体 adds emphasis to questions.

text: くそ見つかった / 期待2Dからの緊急援護申請 / サーバー切断ボディユニット起動 / 了解
translation: Damn, I've been found / Emergency support request from Unit 2B / Disconnect from server, activate body unit / Understood

vocabulary.meaning: to be found, to be discovered

grammar: Past tense た indicates completed action. からの indicates 'from'. 期待 appears to be 機体 (きたい) 'unit'. ボディユニット is 'body unit'.

text: オペレーターさん何があったの / 実は廃坑上エリア全域に機械生命体の反応多数確認
translation: Operator, what happened? / Actually, we've confirmed numerous machine lifeform reactions across the entire abandoned mine area
grammar: の is question particle. に indicates location. オペレーター is 'operator'. エリア is 'area'.

text: その後、2Bから支援要請があったけれど、電波状況が悪く…
translation: After that, there was a support request from 2B, but the signal conditions were poor...
grammar: けれど indicates contrast 'but/however'. く is adverbial form of 悪い. The trailing … indicates incomplete thought.

text: わかった!こっちも大型ターミナルからアクセスしてみる!
translation: Got it! I'll try accessing from the large terminal too!
grammar: も means 'also/too'. てみる means 'to try doing'. ターミナル is 'terminal'. アクセス is 'access'.

text: 申請、サーバー管理室の利用
translation: Request: Use of server management room
grammar: の marks possession/relationship. サーバー is 'server'.

text: 申請の許可を確認 / この部屋の装置を…
translation: Request approval confirmed / This room's equipment...
grammar: を marks the object. The trailing … indicates incomplete thought.

text: 2Bのブラックボックス信号現在 / 良かった / 通常通信は不調
translation: 2B's black box signal is active / Thank goodness / Normal communications are malfunctioning

vocabulary.meaning: present, current (likely 健在 けんざい 'alive/active')

grammar: Past tense た with かった indicates relief. ブラックボックス is 'black box'.

text: 向こうに直接進入して操作するしかない
translation: There's no choice but to infiltrate there directly and operate it
grammar: して connects actions. しかない means 'no choice but to, only option is'.

text: 次はこのまま
translation: Next, just like this...
grammar: Sentence appears incomplete.

text: 2Bのいる部屋のロックを解除
translation: Unlock the room where 2B is
grammar: いる indicates current location/state. ロック is 'lock'.

text: 2Bのいる部屋に向かうには / このままの工場の仮想に向かえばいいのか
translation: To head to the room where 2B is... Should I just head to the factory's virtual space as is?
grammar: には indicates purpose 'in order to'. ば is conditional 'if'. いい means 'it's good/okay'. のか asks for confirmation.

text: 死んで神になる
translation: Die and become god
grammar: て form connects sequential actions.

text: 何を考えてる? / 回路が壊れたのか?
translation: What are you thinking? / Have your circuits broken?
grammar: てる is contraction of ている. のか is question particle. Past tense た with か asks for confirmation.

text: 神になるのだ! / 神になるのだ!
translation: We will become god! / We will become god!
grammar: のだ emphasizes assertion/explanation.

text: 神になるのだ!
translation: We will become god!

text: 一体、みんなに何が起こったか言うのだ?
translation: What on earth happened to everyone?
grammar: に marks the target. Past tense た with か asks what happened. Note: か言うのだ appears to be a transcription error, likely just のだ or んだ.

text: ДИНАМИЧНАЯ МУЗЫКА
translation: [Dynamic Music - not Japanese dialogue]
grammar: This appears to be Russian text meaning 'dynamic music', likely a caption or subtitle error.

text: 이 러버스의 전환이 아직도 가능합니다.
translation: [Korean text - not Japanese dialogue]
grammar: This is Korean text, not Japanese.

text: ДИНАМИЧНАЯ МУЗЫКА
translation: [Dynamic Music - not Japanese dialogue]
grammar: Russian caption text.

text: お疲れ様でした
translation: Good work / Thank you for your hard work

vocabulary.meaning: good work, thank you for your effort

grammar: でした is polite past tense. Standard polite phrase after completing work.

text: 第1話 第1
translation: Episode 1, Part 1
grammar: 第 is used for ordinal numbers. Likely a chapter/episode marker.

text: ДИНАМИЧНАЯ МУЗЫКА
translation: [Dynamic Music - not Japanese dialogue]
grammar: Russian caption text.

text: このエレベーターをハッキングで起動させれば / 2Bたちが脱出することができますね
translation: If I activate this elevator by hacking / 2B and the others will be able to escape, right?
grammar: ば is conditional 'if'. ことができる means 'to be able to'. ね seeks confirmation. エレベーター is 'elevator'. ハッキング is 'hacking'.

text: 待て待て待て2B / 僕です9Sです
translation: Wait, wait, wait, 2B / It's me, it's 9S
grammar: 待て is imperative form. です emphasizes identity.

text: バンカーからハッキングしてこの機械生命体をコントロールしています / これから工場のシステムに侵入し、お二人を脱出させます
translation: I'm hacking from the Bunker and controlling this machine lifeform / From now I'll infiltrate the factory's system and get you two out
grammar: している indicates ongoing action. これから means 'from now on'. し connects actions. バンカー is 'bunker'. ハッキング is 'hacking'. コントロール is 'control'. システム is 'system'.

text: わかった、お願い
translation: Understood, please do
grammar: Past tense わかった indicates understanding. お願い is short for お願いします.

text: 2Bの脱出経路を確保しないと
translation: I have to secure 2B's escape route
grammar: ないと implies obligation 'must do, have to'. Literally 'if I don't...'

text: 「最初
translation: First...
grammar: Opening quotation mark suggests this is incomplete dialogue.

text: 次回予告
translation: Next episode preview
grammar: Standard phrase for episode previews.

text: 第2ゲート解除 / ゲートのロックを解除しました / 先に進んでください / 分かった
translation: Gate 2 unlocked / I've unlocked the gate / Please proceed forward / Got it
grammar: ました is polite past tense. てください is polite request. ゲート is 'gate'.

text: 解放したぞ / 出口までのルート、確保完了です
translation: I've freed it / Route to the exit has been secured
grammar: ぞ is masculine emphatic particle. です is polite copula. ルート is 'route'.

text: ありがとう / 報告 / 2Dには大型の機械生命体と交戦中
translation: Thank you / Report: 2B is currently engaged in combat with a large machine lifeform
grammar: は topic marker. と indicates 'with'. 中 indicates ongoing action. Note: 2D appears to be 2B.

text: 大型機械生命体は工場施設より電力供給を受けていることを確認
translation: Confirmed that the large machine lifeform is receiving power supply from the factory facility
grammar: ている indicates ongoing state. こと nominalizes the clause. を marks the object of 確認.

text: 推奨 / 工場施設のメインフレームに侵入し電力停止を完工
translation: Recommendation: Infiltrate the factory facility's mainframe and complete power shutdown

vocabulary.meaning: completion (likely 完了 かんりょう)

grammar: し connects sequential actions. を marks the object. メインフレーム is 'mainframe'.

text: ナイエス / 今遭遇している大型機械生命体が / 大丈夫です
translation: Nice / The large machine lifeform we're encountering now... / It's alright
grammar: している indicates ongoing action. が is subject marker but sentence seems incomplete. ナイエス is 'nice' in English.

text: モニターしても工場システム小枠20%
translation: Even monitoring, factory system control is only 20%
grammar: ても means 'even if/even though'. モニター is 'monitor'. システム is 'system'. 小枠 appears to be 掌握 (しょうあく) 'control/grasp'.

text: トゥビー、なんとか工場システム掌握50%
translation: 2B, somehow factory system control is at 50%
grammar: なんとか means 'somehow/barely managed'. トゥビー is 2B.

text: あと、この怖さへなんとかすれば
translation: Also, if I can somehow deal with this scary thing...
grammar: すれば is conditional 'if I do'. Note: 怖さ may be a mishearing, possibly 防御 (ぼうぎょ) 'defense' or similar.

text: 90%、90% / 電源研究を停止させました、トゥビー
translation: 90%, 90% / I've stopped the power supply, 2B
grammar: ました is polite past tense. Note: 研究 (けんきゅう) 'research' is likely 供給 (きょうきゅう) 'supply'.

text: あなたの戦いと冒険を経て 預言者は言う
translation: Through your battles and adventures, the prophet says
grammar: を経て means 'through, after going through'. Same religious text as earlier.

text: ああ、大地の慈悲よ / ああ、天上の喜びよ
translation: Ah, mercy of the earth / Ah, joy of heaven
grammar: よ adds emotional emphasis, often in poetry/prayer. This corrects earlier segment - it is indeed 大地 not 男女.

text: 鉄の首輝きから解き放たれ / 私たちの魂は救済されるだろう
translation: Released from iron shackles / Our souls will be saved

vocabulary.meaning: likely 首輪 (くびわ) collar/shackles or 軛 (くびき) yoke

grammar: れ is passive form. される is passive. だろう indicates supposition/future.

text: 永遠に
translation: Eternally
grammar: に marks the manner/state.

text: 永遠に
translation: Eternally
grammar: Repetition for emphasis.

text: 今のは月面サーバーで聞いた言葉 / どうして / 報告、2Bによる敵大型兵器の撃破 / ああ、そうか、わかった
translation: That just now was the words I heard on the lunar server / Why... / Report: 2B has destroyed the enemy's large weapon / Ah, I see, understood
grammar: で indicates location/means. Past tense た indicates completed action. による means 'by/due to'.

text: 司令官 / すまないが司令部まで来てくれ
translation: Commander / Sorry, but please come to the command center
grammar: が indicates contrast 'but'. てくれ is casual request form.

text: 了解しました
translation: Understood
grammar: ました is polite past tense making this more formal than 了解.

text: 君がメインサーバーにアクセスしていた痕跡が残っていた / そのことで聞きたいことがあります
translation: Traces remained showing you were accessing the main server / I have some things I want to ask you about that
grammar: ていた is past progressive. が marks the subject. で indicates 'regarding'. たい expresses desire. メインサーバー is 'main server'. アクセス is 'access'.

text: 司令官 / ヨルハ計画の中に月面人類会議の設立記録がありました
translation: Commander / Inside the YoRHa Project there was a record of the establishment of the Lunar Council of Humanity
grammar: の中に means 'inside of'. ありました is polite past tense of ある.

text: これじゃ順番が逆です / まるで僕たちヨルハ部隊が人類会議を作ったかのような
translation: This way the order is backwards / It's as if we YoRHa forces created the Council of Humanity
grammar: です makes it polite. まるで...かのような is a set pattern meaning 'as if/just like'. Past tense た with かのような creates hypothetical comparison.

text: その通りだ / 月面の人類会議サーバーは我々が設置した / じゃあ人類はもういない
translation: That's correct / We installed the Council of Humanity server on the lunar surface / Then humanity no longer exists
grammar: だ is plain copula. が marks the subject. Past tense た indicates completed action. じゃあ is casual 'then/in that case'.

text: 正確に言えば人類は月には行っていない / 月からの通信はプログラムで用意されたダミーに過ぎない
translation: To be precise, humanity never went to the moon / The communications from the moon are nothing more than dummies prepared by a program
grammar: に言えば is conditional 'if I say'. ていない is negative progressive 'haven't been doing'. された is passive 'was done'. に過ぎない means 'nothing more than'. プログラム is 'program'. ダミー is 'dummy'.

text: 月に残っているのはわずかな人類の遺伝子情報だけだ
translation: All that remains on the moon is just a small amount of humanity's genetic information
grammar: ている indicates current state. のは nominalizes the clause. だけだ emphasizes 'only'.

text: なんでそんなことを / 異星人が襲来した時にはすでに人類は滅亡してしまっていた / このチップに全ての記録を保存してある / 興味があるなら見てみればいい
translation: Why would you do such a thing? / When the aliens attacked, humanity had already perished / All the records are stored on this chip / If you're interested, you can take a look
grammar: には marks time/condition. てしまっていた indicates regrettable completed state in past. てある indicates resultant state. なら is conditional 'if'. てみれば suggests trying. チップ is 'chip'.

text: どうしてこれを僕に
translation: Why give this to me?
grammar: Sentence is incomplete but implies giving/showing. に indicates recipient.

text: 理由なく戦える者などいない / 我々には命を捧げるに値する神が必要なのだ
translation: There is no one who can fight without a reason / We need a god worthy of dedicating our lives to
grammar: なく means 'without'. など dismissively means 'such things'. には marks topic. に値する means 'worthy of'. のだ emphasizes explanation.

text: 自分で決めるんだな
translation: You'll decide for yourself, won't you
grammar: で marks means. んだ is explanatory. な is confirmatory particle.

text: これからどうするか
translation: What you'll do from now on
grammar: か marks indirect question. This completes the previous sentence's thought.

text: どうして… / どうして死んだんだ
translation: Why... / Why did you die?
grammar: んだ is explanatory/emotional emphasis. Past tense た indicates completed action.

text: 兄ちゃん / どうしてなんだよ
translation: Big brother... / Why is this happening?
grammar: んだ is explanatory. よ is emphatic particle showing emotion.

text: くっ! / すべ!
translation: Ugh! / Die!
grammar: すべ appears to be an aggressive exclamation, possibly 死ね (しね) 'die!' or similar battle cry.

text: すべ! / 殺してやる!
translation: Die! / I'll kill you!
grammar: てやる is aggressive volitional form showing hostile intent toward the listener.
